## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `197f87e09e9bedb5deaa9de96d64f5a508265795`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md,scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (L86, L170–171, L311), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md (L41–43), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/security.md (L17, L49), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md (§7–9), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md (L25, L27, L67), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/instrument-discipline.md (L6–9), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md (L36), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (`request:triage`, L1280/L1391), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (ceiling and 120-byte rule), .github/workflows/merge-queue-triage.yml (L730)

Inputs read: card #29682 body and both comments (the claim and the os-dev-report); PR #29940 body, file list (3 files, +245/−2) and the net diff against `main` at merge base `21510bba`; the check-runs on the head. The diff is one commit; the three `hits` paths are the whole diff, so there is no TIER_DEFAULT remainder.

Check-runs on the head at the time of writing: every completed non-skipped run is `success` — `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Type Check · workspace/source gates/consumer gates/debt ledger`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Live required-set sweep`, `Platform checklist gate sweep`, `Release section-coverage sweep`, `Test Core (2/8)`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`. Still `in_progress`: `Test Core (1/8)`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Live half-state sweep`. Recorded as they are; none has concluded red.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No accept-set or public-surface change.** The diff touches `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only; nothing under `packages/`, no schema, no error code, no CLI flag. Right.
- **Lane rule (execution-duties.md L63).** Adds an obligation on the execution seat: a candidate with no triage audit comment is knocked in the same round with the existing `Request: triage · #n · first-touch audit`, and the gap is never reported to the maintainer in the mailbox's place. Reuses the `request:triage` key (`record-recognisers.mjs` L1280; the template is `Request: triage · #n · ONE-LINE-QUESTION`, and the reader at L1391 accepts any one-line tail with one `#n`). No new key, no new label. Right.
- **Placement, not SKILL.md L171.** Judged and holds: SKILL.md L86 names `references/execution-duties.md` as what the execution seat reads every fire (候选与批次 · 认领 · …); the generic doorbell line 「⛔ 不静默等分诊:敲信箱键」 sits at L62 of that file, so the specific knock lands directly under the generic one, where the actor reads it; SKILL.md L171 keeps the ⛔ (no claim without audit) and the new line adds only the remedy. One place, as the card asked. Right.
- **Triage rule (lanes/triage.md L16).** Adds a sweep derivation (`pm:queue`/`pm:blocked` with no audit comment) and the duty to audit each as an ungraded first touch and report the count. The exemption list is delegated to the script row by pointer (「豁免照 H74 行」); the vocabulary 「H 行」 exists on `main` (execution-duties.md L4 「H 行是读数不是前提」), so the pointer is readable. Right, with one caveat under ④ (the row's exempt list is narrower than SKILL.md L170's).
- **Two paid deletions.** lanes/triage.md L20 (vacant `security#1` → §7): restated on `main` by lanes/security.md L17 「中继拒或本席空缺照第 3、9 节」 and L49 「本席空缺时分诊照第 7 节处置」, and security-findings.md §8 forbids a second copy. Right. execution-duties.md L120 (downgrade tier and reason on the claim comment; tier passed explicitly every dispatch): the second half is restated by L121 (effort 与档位并列 … 派发显式传参,⛔ 不留空); the first half is only partly restated — SKILL.md L311's `model:` field asks for the tier word and a `reason:` **for the ceiling tier**, not for a downgrade. Wrong in part — ④ names it should-fix.
- **H74 row.** Report-only: no label write, no comment, no exit code, band `state`; two new keys on `SWEEP_COUNT_KEYS` (forwarded by `Object.fromEntries(SWEEP_COUNT_KEYS.map(…))` at L21140, so the pair reaches the summary); one summary clause anchor placed in rendered order (after H55's sentence, before H19's — matches the self-test's order pin); one battery on the frozen roster. The maintainer's verbatim word is quoted in the row's header comment and on the card, as instrument-discipline.md L9 asks of a new patrol row. Right.
- **Changeset.** `skip-changeset` label, `Check Changeset` green, nothing published. Right.

### ② Semver level

Nothing published: no package path in the diff. `skip-changeset` is correct and the `Check Changeset` run is green. `Clause-②: no` is on the PR body with no `(narrowing)` arm — right: no published accept-set is narrowed, no declared contract is touched; the rules text and a report-only sweep row carry no clause-② surface. The `Metadata-protocol: none` line is right for the same reason.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev declared four deviations on the os-dev-report, one acceptance-note flag and one out-of-scope finding; `open_questions` is empty. Each answered:

1. **One knock per card (card: "one doorbell per card or one listing several").** Holds. `record-recognisers.mjs` L1391 reads exactly one `#n` on `request:triage` (self-test at L2830 pins `numbers.join() === '27123'`); a listing knock would be a half-state under the mailbox line rule (one event, one line). Accepted.
2. **Vacant triage → director not restated.** Does **not** hold as justified. The PR body says the mailbox table "already routes a vacant triage to the director"; on `main` that routing exists only on the `Request: main-red` row (project-forms.md L42 「分诊(缺则总监)」) — the `Request: triage` row (L43) has no vacancy clause, and no general vacant-seat rule exists in SKILL.md, seat-lifecycle.md, project-forms.md or lanes/director.md (grep `空缺` is empty on all four; cross-repo-coordination.md L36 covers only a session-type execution PM sweeping as triage in a multi-lane repo). The new lane line is 108 bytes, so the 120-byte cap left room for a short clause, and project-forms.md L42 shows the four-character idiom. Net effect: a lane facing a vacant triage is told ⛔ not to report to the maintainer and given no route — the shape the card was filed against. Should-fix (④ item 1).
3. **No PR subscription; worktree detached.** Procedural per os-dev.md; no bearing on the tree. Accepted.
4. **`[maintainer]` title prefix has no spelling on `main`** (acceptance note). The dev flagged it honestly. On `main` there is no `[maintainer]` title convention in `.claude/**`, `scripts/**` or AGENTS.md; the repo's reading of a maintainer-filed card is SKILL.md's 非车队卡 (author not `Bot` and first line not a seat signature, execution-duties.md L55). As committed, the exemption matches nothing, so it is a no-op and the card's intent (a card the maintainer filed with labels by hand is not an unaudited queue card) is unmet. Escalated to the card's author for the intended spelling; should-fix (④ item 4).
5. **Cost: no cap on the H74 thread buy.** The dev measured 33 + 23 as the ceiling and the buy rides the shared `commentsFor` cache (one page per body-clean member, free when H2/H4 already fetched). H55 buys the same way without a cap; the summary pair reports any shortfall and an unread thread fires its own UNJUDGED row. Accepted.
6. **Out-of-scope finding** (release-section-coverage `--strict` red on `main` for the v18 page). Not this diff's; the `Release section-coverage sweep` run on the head is green. Noted, not reviewed.

### ④ Design judgment

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`** — judged against SKILL.md L170–171 (the rule it remedies), L62 (the generic knock), project-forms.md L41–43 (the mailbox table), the `request:triage` reader, and the ratchet (188/188, widest line 120 bytes on `main` and on the head).

1. **Should-fix — the vacant-triage route is missing and the reason given for dropping it is wrong.** See ③ item 2. The fix is one of: add 「(分诊缺则总监)」 or the L42 idiom to the new line (rewording within 120 bytes), or add the vacancy clause to project-forms.md L43 where the generic knock line already points (that row is at 120 bytes and the file at 58 lines, so it would need its own reword or a paid line).
2. **Should-fix — the paid deletion drops a rule that is only half restated.** L120 on `main` required the downgraded tier **and its reason** on the claim comment's Container & model line. SKILL.md L311 asks for the tier word and a `reason:` only when the ceiling tier is served; L118–119 name the two downgrade exits and the seat-post note for a temporary deviation but do not require the reason on the claim comment; no instrument reads it (H65 judges triage-round tier naming, not claims). The downgrade itself stays controlled by L105–106 (contract-review-tier review as the compensating control), so this is a lost audit trail, not a lost gate. Pay the new line with a different deletion, or keep the reason clause by folding it into L118.
3. **Holds** — the line sits under the generic knock, reuses the existing key with a one-line tail the reader accepts, keeps the ⛔ against reporting to the maintainer in the mailbox's place (the maintainer's word), is 108 bytes, and the file count is unchanged. The 「候选缺审计评论」 wording leaves SKILL.md L170's two exemptions (sub-issue inheriting the parent's domain; main-red anchor) to be read from SKILL.md, which the seat reads first; acceptable as one place.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md`** — judged against triage-duties.md L19/L25/L27/L67 (first touch and the audit comment), lanes/security.md L17/L49 and security-findings.md §7–9 (the deleted line), and the ratchet (20/20, widest 120 bytes).

4. **Holds** — the sweep line adds the derivation the card asked for, names the first-touch remedy (triage-duties.md L67 is the audit-comment shape the row reads) and the round-record count, and delegates the exempt list to the row by pointer. The deleted `security#1` line is a true restatement (lanes/security.md L49 already tells the triage seat what to do when `security#1` is vacant, and the surviving line above it still points at `security.md`). The new line is exactly 120 bytes — at the cap, not over.
5. **Caveat, carried by the script finding below** — because the exempt list lives only in the row, every gap in the row's list becomes a triage duty (「照未定级首触补审计」) on a card the protocol says needs no audit.

**`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`** — judged against the card's Change 2–3 and Acceptance, SKILL.md L170 (the audit-exempt classes on `main`), `isTriageRulingComment`/`TRIAGE_RULING_ANCHORS` (L8107–8130), `readSignatureLine`/`stripSignatureLine` (the signature-tolerant read), `SEEN_LABEL_PAGES` (L22550: `pm:queue` and `pm:blocked` are both pages the loop consumes, so membership is free and by construction), the H55 gated-fetch pattern it copies, `SWEEP_COUNT_KEYS` forwarding (L21140), `SUMMARY_CLAUSE_ANCHORS` order pins (L29149–29151), `familyBand`/`familyRegistryCoverage`, the frozen `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` roster, and `merge-queue-triage.yml` L730 (`queue-flake-anchor` is the anchor label it stamps).

6. **Should-fix — the exempt list omits the protocol's own audit-exempt classes.** SKILL.md L170: 「两例外:sub-issue 承父卡域、main-red 锚卡,免审计评论」. H74 exempts the card's six labels plus a title prefix, none of which names a sub-issue. A sub-issue filed under a parent with its inherited domain, grade and `pm:queue` — the protocol-blessed shape — fires H74 every sweep, and the row's text asserts it is "invisible to both sides" and tells triage to audit it in this round, which the protocol says is not owed. For the main-red anchor, triage-duties.md L25 says the first-touch record is owed after the fact, so a firing until it lands is defensible. The sub-issue case is the gap. The list payload carries no free parent signal; the fetch class already in this file (`subIssueParentPath`, L20929, used by H45) is the read that answers it, or the card's author can rule the sub-issue class into the exempt list by its own spelling. Report-only, overturnable by a seat's sentence (instrument-discipline.md L6), so not a FAIL — but it is a systematic class, not a stray.
7. **Should-fix — `H74_MAINTAINER_TITLE` matches nothing on `main`.** See ③ item 4. As is, the maintainer's hand-filed cards are in the population; a self-test pins a spelling that no card carries.
8. **Holds — the record reader.** `isTriageAuditRecord` is the union the card asked for: the older `Triage:` openings via `isTriageRulingComment` (signature-tolerant, so the lane self-triage of SKILL.md L171's third exception reads as a record), and the signed shape (first non-blank line parses as a `triage#N` signature, heading `## Triage` to `###### Triage` anywhere below, fences stripped so a quoted template is a citation). Pure; no fetch. The pinned asymmetry (a `## Triage` heading as the first line reads under the older anchor whatever the signature) is H33's existing reading, pinned rather than silently changed — right.
9. **Holds — population and thread states.** Issues only, open only, unreadable `labels` out (not read as unlabelled), `pm:dispatched` out (H2's subject). Three thread states on the #4690 contract: `undefined` silent, `null` UNJUDGED, array judged; the summary pair counts candidates vs probed and names the UNJUDGED row on shortfall. The gather is idempotent and the candidate counter increments once per card. The row text carries no angle bracket and no tracker number (pinned), names both remedies and the report-only boundary, and is not a loud finding (pinned).
10. **Holds — wiring.** The band entry, the count keys on the enumerated forwarding contract, the clause anchor in rendered order, the battery on the frozen roster with a positive pin under the count (37 cases, pin 32), and emitted-code coverage are each pinned. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` are green on the head.
11. **Observation, no fix owed** — `isTriageRulingComment`'s `/^triage\b/iu` anchor also matches a card body or comment whose first non-signature line merely begins with the word "Triage" (e.g. a lane's "Triage requested …" note), which H74 would then read as an audit record. Pre-existing H33 reading, inherited unchanged; worth a tighter positive control if the row ever stops being report-only.

**Must-fix:** none. **Should-fix:** items 1, 2, 6, 7.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-28iqp6`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `bea5334987c2f611a21a30dd686d6869de7d46d4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md,scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (L170–171, L311), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md (L42–43), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md (L25), .github/workflows/fleet-patrols.yml (L497–503, the `platform-checklist-watchdog` anchor), .github/workflows/scheduled-full-run-card.yml (L36–38, L95), .github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml (L148–151), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (ceiling and 120-byte rule); in check-half-states.mjs the cited code `artefactAuthor`, `readSignatureLine`, `h67ReadOrder` and its battery (L35617–35636 on `main`), the H45 parent read (L25028–25040) and `rest`'s error shape (L21018–21019), `subIssueParentPath`

Round 1, after record 6609708274 on head `197f87e0`. Inputs: the delta `git diff 197f87e0 bea53349` (one new commit, execution-duties.md 2 lines reworded, check-half-states.mjs +~115), the net diff against `origin/main` (3 files, +356/−9), the card (no new comment since the os-dev-report), the PR body as it stands on this head, the round-1 commit message (the dev's only account of the round), and the check-runs on `bea53349`. `main` moved from `21510bba` to `6a4737ab`; `git diff 21510bba origin/main` over the three `hits` paths, SKILL.md and project-forms.md is empty, so nothing on `main` touched this surface and the merge base is unchanged. The three `hits` paths are still the whole diff; no TIER_DEFAULT remainder.

Check-runs on `bea53349` at the time of writing: completed non-skipped runs are all `success` — `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Live required-set sweep`, `Platform checklist gate sweep`, `Release section-coverage sweep`, `Snapshot the board`, `Lint · scoped · query-options erasure`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Auto Label`, `filter`. Still `in_progress`: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, the four `Type Check ·` lanes, `Live half-state sweep`, `Plan Test Core shards`. None has concluded red. The self-test battery count (pin 46) and the ratchet are therefore read from the tree here, with CI's reading still owed.

### ① Derived judgments

Round 1 after 6609708274. The four round-0 should-fixes and what the delta does with each:

- **r0-1, vacant triage → director (execution-duties.md L63).** Taken. The line now reads 「缺审计评论当轮敲 `Request: triage · #n · first-touch audit`,分诊空席敲总监,⛔ 不改报维护者」 — 119 bytes, the project-forms.md L42 idiom in substance. Right. Dropping 「候选」 is harmless: the line sits in 〈候选与批次〉 under the generic knock.
- **r0-2, the downgrade reason (execution-duties.md L120–121).** Taken by folding: L120 stays deleted and L121 becomes 「effort 按卡难度定,与档位、降档理由写进 Container & model 行与派发令,显式传参,⛔ 不留空」 — 119 bytes. The downgraded tier and its reason are again required on the claim comment's Container & model line (and on the dispatch order, which is new but consistent with L121's existing 「与派发令」). File stays 188/188, widest 120. Right.
- **r0-3, SKILL.md L170's audit-exempt classes in H74.** Taken for both classes. Sub-issue: `h74InheritsFromParent` exempts a card whose parent row carries one of the card's own `domain:*` or `priority:*` labels, bought through H45's fetch class (`subIssueParentPath`) with H45's 404 reading; judged under ④. Main-red anchor: `H74_MAIN_RED_ANCHOR_TITLE`, measured title openings; one in-tree anchor template falls outside it — should-fix under ④.
- **r0-4, `[maintainer]` cards.** Taken as the seat directed: read as SKILL.md's 非车队卡 via a new shared `isFleetCard` (seat-signed body ⇒ fleet; otherwise fleet unless `artefactAuthor` reads a non-App author; an unreadable author is the fleet's). `h74SpeaksAbout` now drops non-fleet cards before any thread read. Right.
- **H67's switch to `isFleetCard` — behaviour outside the card.** Judged: no reading changes. The replaced closure returned 1 when `readSignatureLine(body) !== null`, else `author && !author.isApp ? 0 : 1`; `isFleetCard` returns true on a signature, else `!(author && !author.isApp)`, and the new leg is `isFleetCard ? 1 : 0` — the same truth table on all four inputs (signed body, human author, App author, unreadable author). Pinned twice: H67's own battery on `main` already pins each leg (`⭐ H67 order: a HUMAN account whose body opens with a seat signature is the fleet's`, `…signature off its first line is still reached first`, `every App author is the fleet's … and an unreadable author ⛔ is never promoted`), which the delta leaves in place, and BATTERY74 adds a cross-pin (`the one isFleetCard drives H67's order leg too`). Adequate.
- **No accept-set or public-surface change**, as in round 0; `SWEEP_COUNT_KEYS`, clause anchor and band are unchanged by the delta; the battery pin rises 32 → 46 (count on the tree ≈ 56). Right.
- **Line ratchet.** 188/188 and 20/20, widest line 120 bytes, no line over the cap; no raise taken. Right.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from round 0: nothing published, `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the delta adds nothing that could alter it. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

No round-1 os-dev-report on the card and no new `open_questions`; the commit message is the dev's declaration. Items judged:

1. **The PR body is stale on this head.** It still declares, in 〈What changes〉 and 〈Acceptance notes〉, that the vacant-triage → director route is "not restated" with the rejected reason, names the `[maintainer]` title exemption, and reports the battery as `37/32`; the tree now does the opposite on all three. The declaration lines (`Clause-②`, `Metadata-protocol`) are still right. Should-fix (④ item 4): bring the deviation list, the exempt-list sentence, the Tests line and the cost note (the parent read is a new per-card purchase) into line with the tree.
2. **Parent-read cost not declared.** The delta buys one `/parent` read per card that would otherwise fire (≤ the firing set, bounded by the 33 + 23 population), after both channels are read clean. Not capped, not counted in a summary pair; its failure is loud (UNJUDGED row). Accepted as a reading, flagged for the body (item 1).
3. **Round-0 items 1 (one knock per card) and 3 (no subscription, worktree detached)** stand as accepted.

### ④ Design judgment

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`** — against SKILL.md L170–171, L311, project-forms.md L42–43 and the ratchet.

1. **Holds.** Both round-0 should-fixes are closed in the tree at 119 bytes each, file count unchanged, no restatement elsewhere lost. The folded L121 now carries two obligations (effort; tier + downgrade reason) on one line, which is denser than before but within the file's own style.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md`** — unchanged in the delta; the round-0 judgment stands (holds; the exempt list is read off the H74 row by pointer, so ④ items below are what that pointer now resolves to).

**`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`** — against SKILL.md L170 (the three exemptions), triage-duties.md L25, the anchor-filing workflows, `artefactAuthor`, H45's parent read, `rest`'s thrown `err.status`, and H67's battery.

2. **Should-fix — the main-red anchor exemption misses an in-tree anchor template.** `H74_MAIN_RED_ANCHOR_TITLE` is `^\s*main[ -]red\b` or `:\s*red on main\b`. The in-tree anchor titles: `4-hourly full run: red on main (CI)` and `nightly full run: red on main (UI Coverage)` (scheduled-full-run-card.yml) and `nightly-tiers: red on main` (test-nightly-tiers.yml, labels `bug,domain:devx,priority:p1`) match; `check:platform-checklist is red on main` (fleet-patrols.yml L498) does not — the colon is followed by `platform-checklist is`, not `red on main`. That card is filed by an App (fleet ⇒ in population) with `ANCHOR_ROUTING_LABELS: 'pm:queue,tooling'` and the identity label `platform-checklist-watchdog`, so whenever it is open and carries no triage record it fires H74 every sweep while its three sibling anchors are exempt — an inconsistent exemption rather than a wrong one. The clean fix mirrors `queue-flake-anchor`: add `platform-checklist-watchdog` (the machine's identity label, single-sourced at L497) to `H74_EXEMPT_LABELS`, with a pin beside a non-exempt twin; widening the regex to an unanchored `\bred on main\b` would be the second-best route. Report-only, so not a FAIL.
3. **Holds — the sub-issue exemption and its failure path.** The read is bought last and only for a card whose thread was READ and found clean (`h74NeedsParentRead` is false for `null`/`undefined` bodies and for a card an audit already answers), so an unconsulted or unreadable thread never buys a parent. Four parent states on the predicate: `undefined` (not bought) judges without the exemption; `null` (the documented 404 — `rest` throws with `err.status`, L21018–21019, the same reading H45 takes at L25035) fires the ordinary row; a row exempts only when it shares a `domain:*` or `priority:*` label with the card (SKILL.md L170's 「承父卡域」; a parent sharing neither inherits nothing and the card fires — right, nothing was inherited); any other failure returns the frozen `H74_PARENT_UNREADABLE` sentinel and the row fires UNJUDGED, never clean and never silent (#4690). `h74InheritsFromParent` is pure and refuses `null`, `undefined`, the sentinel and an unreadable `labels` without a crash. The sentinel check sits after the inherits check and before the `null`-thread check, and the sentinel can only arrive with an array of bodies, so the branch order is consistent. All of it pinned (domain parent, grade parent, stranger parent, 404, sentinel, "never excuses an audited or out-of-scope card", gating, inherit-reader edges). One cost of the shape, carried under ③ item 2: the per-card parent read has no coverage pair in the summary sentence, unlike H45's; the UNJUDGED row makes the shortfall visible per card, so this is an observation, not a fix.
4. **Should-fix — the PR body's account.** See ③ item 1. The brief judges the tree, and the tree is right; the body contradicts it on three points, and a reviewer reading only the body would re-raise r0-1 and r0-4.
5. **Holds — `isFleetCard` as the `[maintainer]` reading.** It is execution-duties.md L55's 非车队卡 verbatim (作者非 `Bot` 且首行非席位签名), shared with H67 rather than copied, exported, pure; a seat-operated human account filing with a signature (the card #29682 shape) stays in the population, a human with an unsigned body is out, an unreadable author is never promoted to a human's.
